ports.label: Audio In 1
ports.notes: Mono, balanced captive screw (+, -, ground); max +24 dBu, 8 kOhm; phantom +48 V; paging / music

ports.label: Audio In 2
ports.notes: Mono, balanced captive screw (+, -, ground); max +24 dBu, 8 kOhm; phantom +48 V; paging / music

ports.label: Emitter Out 1 (A)
ports.notes: Zone 1, cable run A: Qt Standard (up to 60) or Qt Active (up to 50) emitters; min. output impedance 2 Ohm per channel

ports.label: Emitter Out 1 (B)
ports.notes: Zone 1, cable run B: Qt Standard (up to 60) or Qt Active (up to 50) emitters; min. output impedance 2 Ohm per channel

ports.label: Emitter Out 2 (A)
ports.notes: Zone 2, cable run A: Qt Standard (up to 60) or Qt Active (up to 50) emitters; min. output impedance 2 Ohm per channel

ports.label: Emitter Out 2 (B)
ports.notes: Zone 2, cable run B: Qt Standard (up to 60) or Qt Active (up to 50) emitters; min. output impedance 2 Ohm per channel

ports.label: Emitter Out 3 (A)
ports.notes: Zone 3, cable run A: Qt Standard (up to 60) or Qt Active (up to 50) emitters; min. output impedance 2 Ohm per channel

ports.label: Emitter Out 3 (B)
ports.notes: Zone 3, cable run B: Qt Standard (up to 60) or Qt Active (up to 50) emitters; min. output impedance 2 Ohm per channel

ports.label: LAN 1
ports.notes: The panel marks the ports 1 and 2 only; the data sheet: dual network ports (media / control), AVB media network on Qt X 300

ports.label: LAN 2
ports.notes: The panel marks the ports 1 and 2 only; the data sheet: dual network ports (media / control), AVB media network on Qt X 300

ports.label: Contact In 1
ports.notes: Contact closure (normally open); input 1 = emergency mute (fire alarm)

ports.label: 24V DC In
ports.notes: 24 VDC 2.7 A from the power supply (100-240 VAC 50/60 Hz, 0.9 A); max. 22 W
